premise: The accepted Antimagic Field source is applied to two real suppressed spells. Healing Rite remains outside the field scope because its exact Cleric card is a nonspell ability without an explicitly magical tag. A valid Vampiric Touch cast inside commits its ordinary price but has no queued payload; the positive ordinary-price spell witness occurs only after natural reversion and field expiry.
assertions: Healing Rite pays2RP and heals S4d8+M5=22 under the exact RW149-F class-feature predicate; it removes no Wound.
Vampiric Touch inside the field commits5RP and Action; it produces no attack, damage, healing or later release.
The field expires68.1; Polymorph expires60.1 and UA66.1 while suppressed, so neither record resumes and no deadline/resource is refreshed.
After lawful reversion, ordinary Vampiric Touch pays5RP, settles T100->88, then heals A72->78 by floor(actualDamageDealt/2).
